title: One order moves through its states, with a payment timeout and a late webhook
captions: The buyer taps Place order. Your service holds the stock for 30 minutes and saves the order as pending_payment, together with the idempotency key from the app.
The payment provider holds the money on the card, so the order moves to authorized. Your service then commits the stock and moves the order to confirmed.
When the parcel leaves the warehouse, the order moves to shipped and you capture the payment. When the courier confirms, the order is delivered.

Sometimes the pay call times out, so you do not know if the card was charged. Ask the provider about this order. If it was paid, go on. If not, keep the order in pending_payment. The buyer can try again until the stock hold ends. Then release the stock.

A late webhook says the payment succeeded, but the order was already cancelled. The transition guard has no rule for cancelled to confirmed, so it refuses. If the payment is only authorized, you cancel it. If it already succeeded, you refund it. Either way, you alert someone.
